story.titleZh: 第19位发车夺冠！安东内利惊险赢得意大利大奖赛
story.summaryZh: 在意大利大奖赛中，基米·安东内利从第19位发车，最终力压梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔和马克斯·维斯塔潘夺冠，成为自1966年以来首位在蒙扎夺冠的意大利车手。
story.originalTitle: Italian GP: Kimi Antonelli sensationally wins thrilling Monza race from George Russell and Max Verstappen
story.summaryEn: Championship leader Kimi Antonelli won the Italian Grand Prix from 19th on the grid, beating Mercedes teammate George Russell and Max Verstappen to become the first Italian winner at Monza since 1966.
detailZh: 意大利大奖赛：基米·安东内利惊险夺目地战胜乔治·拉塞尔和马克斯·维斯塔潘，赢得蒙扎激动人心的比赛
总冠军领跑者基米·安东内利成为自1966年以来首位在蒙扎夺冠的意大利车手，他从第19位发车完成了一场令人难以置信的驾驶；安东内利凭借惊人的速度一路超越对手，随后在比赛尾声追上了乔治·拉塞尔；马克斯·维斯塔潘拿下2026赛季第五个领奖台
2026年意大利大奖赛集锦
基米·安东内利上演了一场非凡的逆转，从第19位发车并赢得他的主场意大利大奖赛，整场比赛他都与梅赛德斯车队队友拉塞尔展开激烈争夺。
由于超出引擎使用配额而受到发车罚退，安东内利原本被预料无法争夺胜利，但他在比赛早期就强势穿越车阵——恰逢勒克莱尔严重撞车引发的红旗期间——并以惊人的速度凭借不同的策略追上了拉塞尔。
两辆梅赛德斯和维斯塔潘在比赛上半程脱离了其他车手，多次交换领先位置，这是由于2026款动力单元造成的“悠悠球”式比赛节奏，以及蒙扎长直道上尾流效应的影响。

第29圈，也就是比赛刚过半程时，兰斯·斯特罗尔把他的阿斯顿·马丁停在了赛道边，虚拟安全车（Virtual Safety Car）出动，安东内利和维斯塔潘随即进站。
完成进站后，两人分别以第六和第七名出站，落后拉塞尔15秒，但他们凭借更新的轮胎轻松地追回到了前列位置。
安东内利在还剩五圈时追上了拉塞尔，但由于赛道表面碎裂，他在第一个减速弯冲出了赛道。不过，他很快就重新咬住拉塞尔的车尾，并在还剩三圈时完成制胜一超，而维斯塔潘则守住了位置，挡开了兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的迈凯伦赛车，夺得第三名。
基米·安东内利从第十九位发车赢得意大利大奖赛冠军
这意味着安东内利在车手积分榜上领先拉塞尔 66 分，而后者预计未来在某场比赛中也将自己接受发车顺位处罚。
“难以置信！我很开心，我从来没有想过今天能站在这里，”安东内利说。
“但我们做到了，我真的、真的非常开心。”
安东内利从第19位发车并夺冠，这是F1历史上第二低的夺冠发车位置（约翰·沃森曾于1983年从第22位赢得长滩大奖赛）
他是自60年前的卢多维科·斯卡菲奥蒂以来，首位赢得意大利大奖赛的意大利车手
凭借职业生涯的第七场胜利，他已经成为自1953年阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里以来最成功的意大利一级方程式车手
他的这场胜利是意大利车手在大奖赛历史上获得的第50场胜利
诺里斯在一个迈凯伦表现挣扎的周末以第四名尽量减少了损失，但在最后几圈与皮亚斯特里进行了一场激烈的争夺，目前在积分榜上落后安东内利96分。
法拉利本来对在蒙扎夺冠寄予厚望，但刘易斯·汉密尔顿仅获得第六名，从第一圈起他就因为被队友勒克莱尔挤进砂石区而感到沮丧，而勒克莱尔在第三圈发生了严重的撞车。
从杆位发车的加斯利缺乏速度，掉到了第七名，排在他前面的是小红牛（小红牛）的林德布拉德、他的阿尔派车队队友科拉平托，以及小红牛（小红牛）的另一名车手角田裕毅。
安东内利如何完成惊艳的逆袭
梅赛德斯车队已经为安东内利制定了另一套策略，让他用硬胎起步，这位积分榜领跑者的发车非常出色，在三圈内从第19位升至第12位，随后勒克莱尔在高速的最后一个弯道发生了严重撞车。
勒克莱尔从事故中安然无恙地走了出来，但比赛被红旗中断以便维修护栏，这让所有车手都可以更换轮胎。
拉塞尔在第二圈从原杆位发车的加斯利手中夺过领先位置，因此将在重启时从杆位发车，而维斯塔潘上升了两个位置，排在第三。
大多数车手换上了硬胎，但维斯塔潘、因第一圈被勒克莱尔挤出赛道进入砂石区而位居第八的汉密尔顿，以及安东内利等六位车手选择了中性胎。
夏尔·勒克莱尔在意大利大奖赛的第一圈发生了严重撞车
拉塞尔守住了领先位置，但被维斯塔潘追上，维斯塔潘很快就超越了加斯利，而且这位红牛车手出人意料地拥有足以超越拉塞尔的速度。
维斯塔潘奋力防守拉塞尔的进攻时，安东内利表现惊人地升至第三，他先后超越了小红牛的两名车手、皮亚斯特里、争冠对手诺里斯和汉密尔顿，以及加斯利，在仅仅13圈之后就处于第三位。
车群挤在一起，于是安东内利加入了维斯塔潘和拉塞尔的缠斗，随着维斯塔潘的轮胎状况更差，这场争斗变成了梅赛德斯的一二名格局。
梅赛德斯希望他们的车手通过使用超车模式互相配合——当车手与前车差距在一秒以内时，该模式允许使用更多的电能输出。
经过几番来回较量，拉塞尔和安东内利逐渐甩开了维斯塔潘。但关键的时刻出现在第29圈，斯特罗尔因可靠性问题停车，触发了虚拟安全车。
基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔在意大利大奖赛的领先争夺中多次并排缠斗
由于拉塞尔使用的是硬胎，梅赛德斯选择让他留在赛道上，而使用中性胎的安东内利和维斯塔潘则进站了。然而，赛后拉塞尔表示，他当时以为安东内利也会留在赛道上不进站。
detailEn: Italian GP: Kimi Antonelli sensationally wins thrilling Monza race from George Russell and Max Verstappen

Championship leader Kimi Antonelli became the first Italian to win at Monza since 1966 after an incredible drive from 19th to first; Antonelli had stunning pace to come through the field, then later caught George Russell in the closing laps; Max Verstappen claimed his fifth podium of 2026
Highlights from the 2026 Italian Grand Prix
Kimi Antonelli completed a remarkable comeback to win his home Italian Grand Prix from 19th place after a race-long battle against Mercedes team-mate George Russell.

Antonelli was not expected to contend for victory due to grid penalties for exceeding his engine allocation but stormed through the field early on - in between the red flag for Charles Leclerc's huge crash - and showed tremendous pace to catch Russell on an alternative strategy.

The two Mercedes and Max Verstappen pulled clear of the field in the first half of the race, exchanging the lead several times, due to the yoyo style of racing caused by the 2026 power units and the impact of having a slipstream around the long straights at Monza.

Antonelli and Verstappen pitted on Lap 29, just after half race distance, when a Virtual Safety Car came out for Lance Stroll stopping in his Aston Martin.
After their pit stops, the pair emerged in sixth and seventh with a 15-second deficit to Russell but comfortably made their way back up to the top positions on fresher tyres.

Antonelli caught Russell with five laps remaining but ran wide at the first chicane due to the track breaking up. However, he was soon back on Russell's tail and made the race-winning move with three laps to go, while Verstappen held off the McLarens of Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri to claim third.
Kimi Antonelli wins the Italian Grand Prix from 19th on the grid
It means Antonelli is 66 points ahead of Russell in the Drivers' Championship with the latter also expected to take grid penalties of his own at a future race.
"Unbelievable! "I am so happy and I could have never imagined to be here today," said Antonelli.
"But we managed to pull it off and I'm really, really happy."
Antonelli’s win from 19th is the second lowest-lowest winning grid position in F1 history (John Watson won Long Beach 1983 from 22nd)
He’s the first Italian to win the Italian Grand Prix since Ludovico Scarfiotti 60 years ago
He’s already the most successful Italian F1 driver since Alberto Ascari (1953) thanks to his seventh career win
His win is the 50th for an Italian in Grand Prix history
Norris limited the damage in fourth on a weekend McLaren struggled, but not without a feisty battle with Piastri during the final laps, and is 96 points behind Antonelli in the standings.

Ferrari had huge hopes to win at Monza but Lewis Hamilton struggled to sixth, having been left frustrated since the opening lap when he was forced into the gravel by team-mate Leclerc who crashed hard on the third lap.
Pole-sitter Pierre Gasly did not have the pace and dropped to seventh, ahead of Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad, his Alpine team-mate Franco Colapinto and the other Racing Bulls of Yuki Tsunoda.
How Antonelli completed stunning comeback

Mercedes had already planned an alternative strategy for Antonelli by starting him on the hard tyres and the championship leader made a phenomenal start to go from 19th to 12th in the three laps before Leclerc's huge shunt at the high-speed final corner.
Leclerc gingerly walked away from the accident but the race was red flagged so the barriers could be repaired, which allowed everyone to switch tyres.
Russell was on pole for the restart after he took the lead on the second lap from original pole-sitter Gasly, while Verstappen made up two spots and was third.
Most drivers put on the hard tyres but Verstappen, Hamilton who was eighth after being edged into the gravel by Leclerc on the first lap, and Antonelli were among six drivers to choose the mediums.
Charles Leclerc had a huge crash on the opening lap of the Italian GP
Russell held onto the lead but was caught by Verstappen, who quickly dispatched Gasly, and the Red Bull driver surprisingly had the speed to overtake Russell too.

While Verstappen defended hard from Russell, Antonelli was remarkably up to third as he overtook the Racing Bulls drivers, Piastri, title rivals Norris and Hamilton, plus Gasly to be in third after just 13 laps.
The field was bunched together so Antonelli joined the Verstappen, Russell scrap which turned into a Mercedes one-two as Verstappen struggled more on his tyres.
Mercedes wanted their drivers to help each other with the use of Overtake Mode - which allows more electrical deployment when a driver is within one second of the car in front.
After some back and forth, Russell and Antonelli slowly pulled away from Verstappen. But, the key moment came on Lap 29 as Stroll stopped with a reliability issue which caused a Virtual Safety Car.
Kimi Antonelli and George Russell go wheel-to-wheel for the Italian Grand Prix lead several times

Given Russell was on hard tyres, Mercedes elected to keep him out but Antonelli and Verstappen pitted as they were on mediums. However, post-race Russell stated he thought Antonelli was also going to stay out.

法拉利周五在巴西的速度落后于梅赛德斯、迈凯伦和红牛，勒克莱尔与汉密尔顿都对赛车平衡不满意；周六第三节练习将于下午2点30分进行，排位赛于下午6点在天空体育F1直播。
圣保罗大奖赛周五各节练习的集锦。
勒克莱尔表示，在圣保罗大奖赛的练习赛中经历了“最糟糕的感觉之一”后，他将对赛车做出“大幅”设定调整。
勒克莱尔在第二次练习赛中落后最快车手安东内利零点七秒，汉密尔顿则落后近半秒，法拉利在周五的速度不及梅赛德斯、迈凯伦和红牛。
这与他们近期的表现形成反差，法拉利在最近四场比赛中都登上了领奖台，但勒克莱尔希望他们能在周六下午2点30分的第三次练习赛和下午6点的排位赛中扭转局面，天空体育F1频道将直播。

勒克莱尔表示：“第二节练习非常棘手。实际上，如果要说的话，这是我今年在车里感觉最糟糕的一次，所以有很多工作要做，而且感觉不太对劲。”
“我有一些想法。我们会大幅调整赛车，看看效果如何。我希望我们能向前迈进一步，因为即使我错过了第一节练习，我也不认为那里有多少性能可挖。”
“只是纯粹的速度不够好。”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔表示，在上周墨西哥城大奖赛与法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿发生冲突后，他已“解决”了两人之间的不和。
汉密尔顿全天都在努力让轮胎达到工作温度，这可能成为整个周末的大问题，因为周六下午排位赛预报有雨，而周日将非常寒冷，气温仅15摄氏度。
“这是充满挑战的一天。赛道非常颠簸且湿滑，这让轮胎很难进入正确的工作窗口，”汉密尔顿说。
“第一节练习整体还可以，但第二节练习更加困难。我们收集了大量有用数据，今晚将与车队一起梳理这些数据，弄清在排位赛前赛车可以在哪些方面改进。”
法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔在墨西哥事件后回答关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题
勒克莱尔：成为父亲是最特别的事情
勒克莱尔的妻子亚历山德拉周三诞下女儿比安卡后，他晚些时候才抵达巴西。
这位29岁的车手成为当前发车区第五位当父亲的一级方程式车手，前四位是马克斯·维斯塔潘、费尔南多·阿隆索、尼科·霍肯伯格和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯。
“这绝对是最特别的事情，”他说。
“你多少会期待这一刻，因为我一直想当个年轻爸爸，而且显然和亚历克斯在一起时，我们觉得时机对了，这是一个非常、非常特别的时刻。这一周绝对会因为我永远记住，全是积极的理由。
“当然，这期间也发生了其他事情。但对我来说，这一周全是关于比安卡的，真是太不可思议了。”

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Charles Leclerc plans 'significant' Ferrari car changes as Lewis Hamilton rues 'difficult' Brazil practice

Ferrari were off the pace compared to Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday in Brazil with both Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton unhappy about the car's balance; watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc says he will make "significant" setup changes to his car after "one of the worst feelings" in practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Leclerc was seven tenths off pace-setter Kimi Antonelli in second practice and Lewis Hamilton was nearly half a second behind as Ferrari trailed Mercedes, McLaren and Red Bull on Friday.

It was a contrast to their recent pace with Ferrari claiming a podium position in the last four races but Leclerc is hoping they can turn that around in final practice on Saturday at 2.30pm and qualifying at 6pm, live on Sky Sports F1.

"FP2 was very tricky. Actually, if anything, one of the worst feeling I've had this year in the car, so there's plenty to work on, and it didn't feel quite right," said Leclerc.

"I've got some ideas. We'll change the car quite significantly, and we'll see how it goes. I hope we can do a step forward because even though I missed FP1, I don't think there was much performance in that.
"It's just the raw pace wasn't great."
Charles Leclerc says he's 'settled' feud with Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton after their clash in last week's Mexico City GP

Hamilton struggled to generate tyre temperature throughout the day, something which could be a big issue throughout the weekend as rain is forecast for Saturday afternoon during qualifying, and Sunday will be very cold at just 15C.
"It was a challenging day. The track is very bumpy and slippery, which made it difficult to get the tyres into the right window," said Hamilton.

"FP1 was okay overall, but FP2 proved more difficult. We've gathered plenty of useful data, so we'll work through that with the team tonight to understand where we can improve the car ahead of qualifying."
Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after their incident in Mexico
Leclerc: Most special thing ever to become a father
Leclerc arrived late to Brazil after his wife Alexandra gave birth to a baby girl named Bianca on Wednesday.
The 29-year-old becomes the fifth Formula 1 driver on the current grid to be a father after Max Verstappen, Fernando Alonso, Nico Hulkenberg and Sergio Perez.
"It's definitely the most special thing ever," he said.

"You kind of expect it because I've always wanted to be a young dad, and obviously with Alex we felt like it was the right time, and it's a very, very special moment. Definitely a week I'll forever remember for all the positive reasons.
"Of course, there's been other things going on as well. But for me, this week was all about Bianca, and it's been it's been incredible."

detailZh: 圣保罗大奖赛：安东内利在英特拉戈斯赛道以梅赛德斯赛车领跑，领先于升级后的迈凯伦车手诺里斯。

圣保罗大奖赛周五练习赛精彩瞬间回顾。
作为F1新世界冠军，安东内利在赛道上完成了令人印象深刻的首日，并在圣保罗大奖赛第二场练习赛中设定了节奏。
在墨西哥成为该运动最年轻冠军五天后，安东内利在第一场练习中取得了第二快的成绩，并在蜿蜒的英特拉戈斯赛道上完成了更具代表性的第二场练习的最快成绩。
安东内利是唯一一位在圈速低于71秒的车手，他的基准时间1:10.763比最接近的挑战者兰多·诺里斯、P1的领跑者以及马克斯·维斯塔潘快了二十分之一秒。

但是，在周五的比赛中，诺里斯凭借自己最快的和第二快的成绩，也可以对自己的表现感到满意，因为麦凯轮车队对其MCL40赛车进行了升级。去年世界冠军，去年在圣保罗的获胜者，在长距离的比赛中也表现出色。
沃金车队是本周末唯一一支使用新部件的车队，他们试图在最后四轮比赛中反击红牛车队，在车队积分榜上超越对手，因为他们在维斯特潘在四场比赛中赢得三场胜利后，被对手超越了第三名。
乔治·拉塞尔紧随诺里斯和维斯特潘之后，在第二辆梅赛德斯赛车中排名第四快。他因为更换了新引擎，在本周末的比赛中将面临五位的发车位罚分。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在另一辆麦凯轮赛车中排名第六。
但是，对于法拉利来说，这似乎是赛道上的一个更艰难的第一天，尤其是在短距离的比赛中。
在墨西哥站第一圈发生碰撞导致车队失去了一次可能的胜利，并促使周四晚上车手与车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔举行会议以澄清情况后，刘易斯·汉密尔顿以第六快的成绩，查尔斯·勒克莱尔以第七快的成绩。
法拉利车队负责人弗雷德里克·瓦瑟尔在两位车手之间发生公开争执后，回答了关于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔的问题。
勒克莱尔在错过周四的媒体日和周五的第一节练习后，在周一从摩纳哥飞回，因为他的第一个孩子比安卡出生。
奥迪车队的尼古拉斯·胡肯伯格是经验丰富的车手中之一，他缺席了新手的开幕式练习，而可靠性问题导致他整日没有完成任何一圈。
在第一节的比赛中，英国年轻车手弗雷迪·斯莱特在仅仅完成了七圈后遇到了技术问题，而车队在第二小时努力修理它时，一个电气问题使得赛车在剩余的时间里都无法参赛。

detailEn: Sao Paulo GP: Kimi Antonelli fastest for Mercedes in second practice at Interlagos ahead of Lando Norris in upgraded McLaren
Watch final practice at 2.30pm ahead Qualifying at 6pm live on Sky Sports F1 on Saturday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
Kimi Antonelli completed an impressive first day back on track as F1's new world champion to set the pace in second practice at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.

Five days after becoming the sport's youngest title winner in Mexico, Antonelli followed up his second-fastest time from first practice with the quickest of the more representative second session around the undulating Interlagos lap.

Antonelli was the only driver to lap below 71 seconds with his benchmark time of 1:10.763 proving two tenths of a second quicker than nearest challengers Lando Norris, the P1 pacesetter, and Max Verstappen.

But with fastest and second-fastest times of his own from Friday, Norris can also be satisfied with his day after McLaren introduced an upgrade to their MCL40 cars. The outgoing world champion, last year's winner in Sao Paulo, appeared quick on the longer runs too.

The Woking team are the only team in the field with new parts this weekend as they bid to hit back against Red Bull in the Constructors' Championship over the final four rounds after being overtaken for third by their rivals after Verstappen's run of three wins in four races.

George Russell was close behind Norris and Verstappen to finish fourth fastest in the second Mercedes. He carries a five-place grid penalty for a fresh engine into the weekend. Oscar Piastri was sixth in the other McLaren.
But it appeared a more difficult first day on track for Ferrari, particularly on the short runs.

Following the first-lap clash that cost the team a likely victory in Mexico, and prompted a Thursday evening meeting between the drivers and team principal Frederic Vasseur to clear the air, Lewis Hamilton was sixth fastest with Charles Leclerc seventh.
Ferrari Team Principal Fred Vasseur answers questions about Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc after a public spat between the two,
Leclerc returned to the track after missing Thursday's media day and then Friday's first session after flying back from Monaco following the birth of his first child, Bianca, earlier this week.
Audi's Nico Hulkenberg was among the experienced drivers to sit out the opening session for rookies and reliability problems meant he ended the day without a lap on the board at all.

A technical problem had already stopped British youngster Freddie Slater after just seven laps while he was in the car in the first session and, while the team worked to repair it for the second hour, an electrical problem kept it sidelined for the rest of the day.
